text: Create a persistent sandbox and execute code in it via SDK call
quote:
const sbx = await Sandbox.create() // Creates a persistent sandbox session
const execution = await sbx.runCode('print("hello world")')

text: List files in the sandbox filesystem
quote: const files = await sbx.files.list('/')

text: Pause a sandbox and resume later with filesystem and memory state intact
quote: Pause a sandbox and resume it later from the exact state it was in, including the filesystem and the memory, so running processes and loaded variables survive.

text: Paused sandboxes are retained indefinitely with no automatic deletion
quote: A paused sandbox is kept indefinitely with no automatic deletion.

text: Reset/extend a running sandbox's timeout dynamically via setTimeout/set_timeout
quote: You can change the sandbox timeout when it's running by calling the `setTimeout` method in JavaScript or `set_timeout` method in Python.

text: Manually shut down a sandbox early via a kill method
quote: You can shutdown the sandbox any time even before the timeout is up by calling the `kill` method.

text: Write files into the sandbox filesystem, including multiple files at once
quote: You can write single files to the sandbox filesystem using the `files.write()` method.

text: Read files from the sandbox filesystem
quote: You can read files from the sandbox filesystem using the `files.read()` method.

text: Run arbitrary terminal commands inside the sandbox
quote: You can run terminal commands inside the sandbox using the `commands.run()` method.

text: Official CLI to manage and interact with sandboxes and templates
quote: E2B CLI is a command line tool that allows you to manage and interact with sandboxes and templates.

text: Control sandbox outbound internet access with on/off switch or allow/deny lists
quote: Every sandbox has outbound internet access by default. Control and restrict it with a simple on/off switch or fine-grained allow and deny lists.

text: Fully pre-configured sandboxes with running processes ready instantly, zero wait time
quote: This gives you fully configured sandboxes with running processes ready to use with zero wait time for your users.

text: View sandbox metrics for CPU, memory, and disk usage
quote: The sandbox metrics allows you to get information about the sandbox's CPU, memory and disk usage.

text: Desktop SDK provides mouse, keyboard, screenshot, and full desktop streaming APIs
quote: For mouse, keyboard, screenshot, application, and desktop streaming APIs, install the Desktop SDK

text: Self-host the E2B infrastructure using provided Terraform-based deployment guide
quote: Read the self-hosting guide to learn how to set up the E2B infrastructure on your own. The infrastructure is deployed using Terraform.

text: Customize sandbox CPU and RAM resources
quote: Customize your Sandbox CPU & RAM

quote:

quote:

text: Define custom sandbox templates specifying base image, env vars, files, setup commands, and start command
quote: E2B templates allow you to define custom sandboxes. You can define the base image, environment variables, files to copy, commands to run, and a start command

text: Open-source infrastructure for running AI-generated code in secure isolated cloud sandboxes
quote: E2B is an open-source infrastructure that allows you to run AI-generated code in secure isolated sandboxes in the cloud.
